depth_calibration.frame: registered optical camera x-right y-down z-forward
depth_calibration.limitations: Published FR3 pinhole camera calibration and zero RGB distortion coefficients; registered depth used without additional pixel undistortion or range correction. Native infrared extrinsics, in-situ calibration verification and vehicle calibration are unavailable.

selection_policy: Fixed original depth indices 100..135 inclusive. Paired each depth timestamp with the nearest recorded RGB timestamp (earlier RGB index resolves exact ties), maximum absolute clock gap 0.02 seconds. All 36 depth observations are retained, including repeated RGB acquisitions; their exact repeated RGB timestamps must cause explicit operational rejection without clock renewal. No interpolation or synthetic image is provided. Fixed selection declared before any RGB/depth/mocap metadata acquisition, pixel decoding or fit scoring. Selection inspected timestamp availability only; walking_rpy candidate 100..135 failed the RGB synchronization criterion before any pixel decoding and was not selected. Sitting_xyz is a genuinely different natural recorded sequence, but physical room/camera independence from other Freiburg 3 sequences is not established. Freeze final algorithms, preprocessing, acceptance, evaluator and independent checker before first pixel decode. Initial frame 100 initializes and all 35 following observations are held out; repeated RGB rejection remains in that denominator.

association_audit.association_rule: nearest RGB timestamp, earlier index on exact tie; no resampling or interpolation
